back: Ek = ½mv² (in joules, with m in kg and v in m/s).

front: What happens to Ek if speed doubles?
back: It becomes four times as large (Ek ∝ v²).

front: Speed after falling a height h from rest (no air resistance)?
back: v = √(2gh); it does not depend on mass.

front: Energy changes in a swinging pendulum?
back: Ep greatest at the top of each swing, Ek greatest at the bottom; slowly lost to heating.

front: Why do real falling objects land slower than calculated?
back: Air resistance transfers some energy to the internal store of the air.
